A Snapshot of Your Day

Are you passionate about health, safety and environmental management and the green transition? As Health and Safety Manager in Projects, you play a significant role in our electrical substation projects for offshore wind farms, Power-to-X and energy transmission. Health and safety is in your hands across the full project lifecycle – from tender and order, through execution on site, until the project is handed over to Services or the client. Projects run from one to several years, and depending on their size and complexity, two to five of them will be in your portfolio at the same time. Acting as HSE advisor and business partner to project managers and leadership, you are part of project discussions and meetings from the start, so safety is built in by design rather than added at the end. Out on site, close collaboration with site teams and site management keeps risks under control and our Zero Harm culture alive every day.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• From tender to handover, you lead all HSE activities in your projects, including HSE planning, the project HSE plan and the health and safety documentation

• Safety by design is central to the role, bringing health and safety into project discussions and meetings from day one

• As HSE advisor and business partner to Project Managers and leadership teams, you support proactive risk management and safe project execution

• On site, risk assessments must be in place – you carry out audits, inspections and safety walks, with the authority to stop work when conditions are unsafe

• Incidents, near misses and environmental events are investigated and followed up using root cause analysis, while HSE performance is tracked through KPIs and trends

• Compliance with HSE legislation, customer requirements and Siemens Energy standards is ensured across subcontractors and suppliers, in dialogue with customers, authorities and certification bodies

• Through training, inductions and visible safety leadership, you drive our Zero Harm culture and share lessons learned across projects

What You Bring

• At least 5 years of experience in health, safety and environmental management from large infrastructure or building projects

• Certification as Occupational Health and Safety Coordinator (Arbejdsmiljøkoordinator P and B)

• An ISO 45001 Auditor Certificate

• A technical background, preferably a bachelor’s or master’s degree

• Strong collaboration skills across professions, departments and borders – reaching out and talking to many people every day, locally and globally, comes naturally to you

• Energy and drive for a busy, varied workday where tasks are solved together with project managers, site managers and technical project managers

• Good English skills, as English is our company language – Danish is considered a plus

About the Team

As part of our Operational Excellence and QHSE team in Ballerup, you will work most closely with two HSE Managers and a work environment engineer – four of you in total. In each project, the project team brings together project managers, technical project managers, contract managers, project planners, engineers, site managers and more, located in Denmark and across Siemens Energy globally. Siemens Energy in Denmark is also home to our global competence centre for complete offshore high-voltage systems that connect offshore wind farms to the onshore grid, serving wind farm owners, shipyards and EPCs worldwide. Some travel is expected for site audits, inspections and supplier audits in Denmark and abroad, always coordinated with your Project Manager and line manager.

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date. Please submit before 23-10-2026

About the Role

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join our Digitalization team as a Customer Solution Manager in Power Generation and Energy Management, where you’ll champion the future of energy across Europe & Africa. You’ll dive into market analysis, competitive benchmarking, and the creation of innovative solutions within our Omnivise Ecosystem. Every day, you’ll define solution concepts, support sales and tendering, and shape go-to-market strategies for control, automation, and digital solutions.

As the vital link between business, customers, sales, and engineering, you’ll ensure complex solutions are clearly defined, developed, and brought to market. Step into a role where your market insight, commercial drive, and collaborative way of working will set new standards for digital energy transformation.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Support solution management activities for the digital ecosystem, guiding concepts from design through commercialization with cross-functional teams.

• Define and promote integrated solution concepts, facilitate customer co-creation sessions, and support internal development efforts.

• Support regional sales and tendering by strengthening solution positioning, contributing to customer workshops, and driving pre-sales engagements.

• Bring regional perspectives and customer insights into digital solution strategies and roadmap development.

• Help align business, sales, customers, and engineering on solution scope, priorities, and delivery readiness.

• Contribute to regional governance and rollout processes, supporting effective portfolio execution.

• Coordinate stakeholders across business development, product management, solution architecture, R&D, cybersecurity, and operations for cohesive delivery.

What You Bring

• Experience supporting tenders, proposals, and customer engagements with a strong focus on value creation.

• Experience of solution development lifecycles, including MVP definition, validation, and scaling.

• Good understanding of digital solutions in power generation and energy management (e.g., SCADA, DCS, EMS, asset and fleet management, control systems, renewable/hybrid integration); experience from industrial applications is also welcome.

• Experience of digital innovation, co-creation with customers, and translating needs into scalable offerings.

• Strong background in cross-functional collaboration, digital solution management, and platform-based business models within energy, automation, or digital industries.

• A digital or software background rather than a purely mechanical one.

• Ability to align stakeholders and drive outcomes in matrix organizations, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Willingness to travel occasionally within Europe.

About the Team

You’ll join a passionate Digitalization team of 11 colleagues, spread across Europe and dedicated to shaping the future of energy across Europe & Africa. The team’s mission is to drive innovation in power generation and energy management by developing and delivering cutting-edge digital solutions. Working closely with business development, product management, engineering, and sales, the team ensures that customer needs are translated into impactful, scalable solutions. Collaboration and open communication are at the heart of how the team operates, fostering a supportive environment where colleagues cover for each other and everyone’s expertise is valued. Together, you’ll champion the digital transformation of the energy sector, delivering solutions that matter.

Our Gas Services division offers low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• Opportunities to work with a global team

• Opportunities to work on a variety of innovative projects

• Medical benefits

• Remote/flexible work

• Time off/paid holidays and parental leave

• Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens-Energy platform

• Access to a variety of employee resource groups

_Would you like to shape the services that help colleagues communicate, collaborate and work productively every day?

_As Service Owner, Collaboration & Productivity, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of these services at GlobalConnect, with Microsoft 365 at the center of your portfolio.

You’ll combine service reliability and governance with the opportunity to shape how our collaboration and productivity services develop over time.

**To Thrive In This Role, You’ll Likely Bring

**

• Several years of experience as a Service Owner, Application Owner, Product Owner or in a similar role, with responsibility for business-critical services or platforms.

• Extensive experience with Microsoft 365 collaboration technologies, including Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online and Microsoft Entra-related dependencies.

• Experience with IT service management and governance, including service transition, incident and problem management, change management and continuous improvement.

• Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and translating business needs into practical, scalable IT solutions.

**About The Role And The Team

**You’ll own the lifecycle of GlobalConnect’s Collaboration & Productivity portfolio, including Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Copilot and other strategic collaboration platforms. Your focus will be to keep these business-critical services secure, reliable and well managed, while continuously improving them and helping set the long-term direction for the area.

You’ll be part of the Digital Workplace organization, in a team of 17 colleagues with experience in IT support, system ownership and specialist roles. Working across business and IT, you’ll also partner with Security, Identity Governance & Administration, system owners and external suppliers. Your work will help ensure employees have effective tools for communication, meetings, document collaboration, knowledge sharing and everyday productivity.

**What You’ll Be Working On

**

• Own the service lifecycle across the collaboration and productivity portfolio, ensuring clear governance, documentation, compliance and operational readiness.

• Define and monitor service-level objectives, availability and user experience; follow up on incidents and recurring problems and make improvements.

• Manage licensing, renewals, budget follow-up, cost control and supplier performance.

• Work with business and technical stakeholders to govern access, information sharing, external collaboration, retention and service lifecycles.

• Manage cross-functional change and adoption initiatives, identifying practical opportunities for automation, AI, standardization and better ways of working.

• Act as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor, connecting employee needs with operational, technical, security and strategic priorities.

**Who We Are Looking For

**You bring structure and a pragmatic approach to service management, and you’re comfortable moving between strategic development and day-to-day operational priorities. You build effective working relationships across business and technical teams, and can assess dependencies, risks and competing needs to move work forward. You’re curious about how collaboration services can evolve, including through responsible use of automation and AI.

Does this sound like you? If so, we’d like to hear from you.

**Practical information

**

• The role is based in Denmark.

• GlobalConnect’s standard setup is at least 3 days per week in the office.

• GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship for this role.

In this role, you’ll have the scope to shape a broad, business-critical portfolio and help make everyday collaboration more secure, reliable and effective for employees.

No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!

**About Us

**GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences.

We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

**Business Introduction

**GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centered on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of oncology-hematology, vaccines, respiratory-immunology-inflammation, and HIV medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Job Purpose

**As Business Unit Head, Oncology, you will lead the Oncology Business Unit in Denmark, with accountability for strategy, commercial performance and people leadership.

You will:

• Lead the Oncology Business Unit in Denmark, shaping strategy, performance and people

• Build, inspire and develop a high-performing commercial team across Sales and Marketing

• Collaborate closely with Medical, Market Access, Supply and country leadership to deliver sustainable growth, prepare for launches and improve patient outcomes.

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

• Lead the commercial P&L, manage budgets and prioritise investment across channels

• Build, coach and develop the commercial team with strong scientific and omnichannel skills

• Set the strategic direction, drive launch readiness and execution plans to achieve the objectives

• Build trusted external relationships with healthcare professionals, payers and patient groups

• Be an active member of the Danish Leadership Team (DLT)

• Ensure compliant, ethical conduct and strong risk management in all external activities.

**Additional information:

**

• Position level: Director

• Reporting line: General Manager Denmark

• Primary location: Vallensbaek Strand Delta Park (Denmark)

• Secondary location: Not applicable

• Presence onsite: hybrid

• People management: Approximately eight (8) direct reports

• Business travel: limited

_**Why You?

**_**Basic Qualification

**_We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals

_

• Master’s degree in a relevant field, such as Business, Science, Pharmacy or a related discipline

• A minimum of 10 years’ experience in comparable leadership roles within the pharmaceutical industry

• Proven experience in Oncology and / or Hematology

• Demonstrated people-leadership experience, including responsibility for Sales and Marketing teams

• Experience leading product launches or major brand life-cycle initiatives

• Strong commercial acumen, including experience managing a P&L or significant budgets

• A strong track record in account management, omnichannel marketing and sales force effectiveness

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

**Preferred Qualification

**_If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus

_

• An advanced degree, such as an MBA or PhD, in a relevant field

• Experience working with Market Access, Health Economics or payer strategy

• Demonstrated ability to lead effectively across matrixed, cross-functional teams

• Fluency in Danish and previous experience in the Danish market

• Global and / or regional and / or Above market experience.

**What We Value In You

**

• A clear, people-first leadership style that develops others and drives accountability

• The ability to make evidence-based decisions and act with appropriate speed

• Strong communication and stakeholder-engagement skills

• A commitment to ethical behaviour, transparency and patient focus

• A passion for continuous learning and improvement.

**How To Apply

**Please submit your CV together with a brief statement outlining how your experience aligns with the role’s responsibilities and qualification requirements. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds who share our commitment to inclusion and collaboration.

Apply now if you are ready to lead the Oncology business in Denmark, broaden your impact and help GSK get ahead of disease together

We look forward to hearing how your experience and leadership will drive better outcomes for patients and the team.

**Application end date

**Sunday, October 25, 2026 – EOD CET

**Skills

**Commercial Strategies, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Danish Language, Hematology, Launch Excellence, Market Access, Market Access Strategies, Oncology, People Leadership, Profit and Loss (P&L) Budget Management, Stakeholder Management

**Why GSK?

****Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

**GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

jobs.occupation: Hands-on Data Engineer or Architect | Databricks & AWS, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about turning data into meaningful business impact? Do you enjoy collaborating with others to solve complex challenges and building modern data platforms that enable better decisions?

At Valcon, we’re growing our Data & AI community and are looking for a Data Engineer who combines technical curiosity with a collaborative mindset. We are particularly interested in professionals with strong Databricks and AWS experience who want to help shape innovative data solutions for some of Denmark’s leading organisations.

The role

As an experienced Data Engineer at Valcon, you’ll work closely with clients, architects, data scientists, and fellow engineers to design, build, and use scalable cloud-based data platforms. You will play a key role in helping organisations transform data into insights, AI solutions, and business value. A significant part of the role will involve working with Databricks and AWS, designing modern data platforms, building robust data pipelines, implementing modern AI/BI tooling, and supporting clients throughout their transformation journeys. Depending on the project, you’ll also work with technologies such as Azure, Python, SQL, Terraform, and PySpark.

What you bring along

• Minimum of 5 years of experience building and using modern data platforms based on Databricks and AWS

• Preferably fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken

• Strong data engineering skills, including data integration, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data modelling

• Familiar with engineering best practices, CI/CD, DevOps, testing, and automation

• Experience from regulated industries such as Life Sciences, Financial Services, Tax Administration, or Defence is an advantage

• A collaborative mindset with a passion for solving complex challenges and creating impact together with clients and colleagues

Why join Valcon?

At Valcon, you’ll become part of a collaborative and welcoming community where knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and professional development are a natural part of everyday life. We offer exciting projects, a transparent career framework, certification opportunities, and strong support for your professional growth. We also believe that great work happens when people thrive, which is why we place a strong emphasis on flexibility, well-being, and family-friendly benefits. Beyond our client work, our community comes together through both professional and social activities, creating an environment where people can build meaningful relationships and feel a sense of belonging.

Interested?

We are looking for talented professionals who are excited by this opportunity and can contribute to our team. While you may not meet every requirement, you should bring strong relevant experience and a genuine passion for data and technology. We invite candidates ongoing to interviews.

jobs.occupation: Commercial Territory Manager, Northern Europe & APAC
jobs.description:
Secomea is growing rapidly across EMEA to meet the growing demand for secure, reliable access in manufacturing.

Secomea is hiring an ambitious Commercial Territory Manager to build out our market in Northern Europe & APAC and help accelerate our growth across one of Europe's most important industrial regions.

This is a true full-cycle sales role. You'll be responsible for generating your own pipeline, qualifying opportunities, managing the sales process from first meeting to signature, and closing new business.

If you're a top-performing Senior BDR looking for your first closing role, or an early-career Account Executive ready for more ownership, this is an opportunity to accelerate your sales career in one of the fastest-growing sectors in enterprise technology.

**Your Role

**As Commercial Territory Manager, you'll own the Nothern European & APAC territory, selling Secomea's Secure Remote Access platform to manufacturers, machine builders and system integrators. This position reports to Secomea’s Regional Manager for Northern Europe/APAC.

You'll build and execute your territory plan, develop new opportunities, manage a healthy sales pipeline, and accurately forecast your business. You'll work closely with our partner network while leading the sales process and building long-term customer relationships.

You'll receive support from our SDR team, marketing, and presales - but success in this role will come from your ability to hunt independently, create pipeline, run a disciplined sales process, and win new business.

This role offers significant autonomy, responsibility, and visibility, making a direct impact on Secomea's continued growth across EMEA.

**What You'll Do

**

• Own and execute the commercial strategy for the Nothern European and APAC territory.

• Generate qualified pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking, partner collaboration, and territory planning.

• Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through demonstrations, commercial negotiations, and closing a signed agreement.

• Build strong relationships with manufacturers, machine builders, system integrators, and channel partners.

• Collaborate with partners to identify and develop new business opportunities.

• Work closely with SDRs, Marketing, Presales, and Customer Success to maximize customer success and revenue growth.

• Maintain an accurate sales forecast and disciplined pipeline management in Salesforce and Clari.

• Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual ARR targets.

• Travel within the Northern region to meet customers and partners, as appropriate.

**What We're Looking For

**We're less interested in years of experience than we are in evidence that you can build pipeline and win business. We want to see the enthusiasm, curiosity, and energy required to thrive in this type of role.

**We imagine you will have:

**

• 1-5 years of B2B sales experience in software, SaaS, industrial technology, cybersecurity or a related technical industry.

• Experience selling to companies HQ’d in Nothern Europe & APAC

• Deep curiosity and desire to understand the people and organizations you work with.

• Experience prospecting and generating your own pipeline.

• Experience managing opportunities through the full sales cycle and closing deals involving MSA, MFA, SoW, and other important paper process.

• Experience achieving or exceeding sales quota.

• Confidence managing forecasts and maintaining CRM hygiene.

• Experience working with sales methodologies (MEDDPPIC; Challenger etc.) is an advantage.

• Experience working with channel partners is a strong advantage.

• Experience selling into manufacturing, industrial automation, OT or cybersecurity is a strong advantage.

**Languages:

**Because you'll operate in an international environment:

• Native or near-native English is essential.

• Dutch is a clear advantage.

**Who You Are:

**

• Competitive and driven by winning new business.

• Resilient, proactive, and focused

• Curious, coachable and eager to develop into a top-performing sales professional.

• Comfortable picking up the phone, prospecting and creating opportunities.

• Highly organized with strong forecasting and pipeline management skills.

• Comfortable selling technical solutions with support from our presales team.

**Why Join Secomea?

**This is an opportunity to join a high-performing sales team in a company with strong product-market fit whilst operating in one of the fastest-growing areas of industrial technology/cybersecurity.

You'll join an environment that will be a springboard to developing into a highly successful salesperson. Expect coaching, constructive feedback, and autonomy, whilst helping global manufacturers secure their critical operations.

**We offer:

**

• A true full-cycle sales role with significant ownership.

• Career progression into larger territory or enterprise sales roles.

• Competitive salary and uncapped commission.

• A fast-growing international company making a real impact in OT cybersecurity.

**About Secomea

**Secomea is a global leader in secure remote access and Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity for manufacturing.

Our platform enables manufacturers, machine builders and system integrators to securely connect to industrial equipment anywhere in the world, reducing downtime while protecting critical infrastructure.

Headquartered in Denmark with offices across North America, Europe and Asia, Secomea serves customers through a global network of partners and continues to expand rapidly as industrial cybersecurity becomes a strategic priority.

**Ready to Apply?

**If you're looking for the opportunity to build your own pipeline, and accelerate your career in B2B technology sales, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV. Or show us how you’d approach a prospective customer by finding and reaching out to the hiring manager.

jobs.occupation: Internship in Water Ecosystem and Business Development
jobs.description:
Would you like to be part of Kamstrup Water’s business development journey, and do you have a passion for solutions that drive sustainable growth? Are you ready to get hands-on experience with Business Development while working on the digital footprint within our Water division? Do you want to kick-start your career and turn your theoretical knowledge into practical experience in an international company?

Here is what the job entails

As an intern in our Water Ecosystem and Business Development team, you will collaborate closely with experienced colleagues to shape the next generation of solutions for water utilities. Your work will focus on exploring the right technologies, markets, and potential partners during the innovation phase. This includes identifying impactful solutions, creating pilots, and generating value propositions and business cases to guide future priorities.

More specifically you will be:

• Conducting desk research to investigate competitive solutions, markets, and potential partners.

• Participating in workshops and webinars to gain insights and foster collaboration.

• Contributing to idea generation sessions with customers or stakeholders to drive innovation.

• Supporting the development of business cases for promising opportunities.

• Assisting in managing projects related to the development and implementation of new solutions.

Meet your future team

You will become a part of a department, that focuses on Business Development within Kamstrup Water business unit. The team consists of 2 dedicated employees and a student worker and is characterized by a youthful atmosphere where new ideas and sparring are the backbone of everything we do. The department is responsible for the expansion and growth of future solutions in the water solutions portfolio on a global scale.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for an analytical-minded student who strives to create valuable commercial impact on our Water business unit. You have a commercial focus combined with a solution orientation mindset which empowers you to translate customer challenges into solutions.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying Global Business Engineering, Business & Water Technology, or a relevant MSc in Economics and Business Administration, Business Development, Business Management, Digital Business Management, or similar. That being said, there are many entry points to this position

• As a person have a curious and creative mindset, allowing you to proactively seek new knowledge and thereby provide new ideas and challenge status quo

• Have a structured approach to your work, enabling you to manage several ongoing tasks while maintaining an overview

• Naturally strive towards ensuring quality results whether you are collaborating with colleagues or working independently

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• A gratuity which may be provided in recognition of your efforts if your place of study allows it as well as paid public transportation to and from work

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Business Development Manager, Amalie Lund, on telephone nr.: +45 89 93 10 00.

At Complir we are building the system to enable safer physical products being sold across markets. The world of product compliance has been stuck in legacy systems, excel sheets and the brains of experts. VP of Quantum - Diasense ApS

Reports to: Marvin Holten, Founder and CTO

Team: Quantum Lead, Quantum Engineers, and part-time specialists in quantum information science and quantum optics, growing through 2027

Location: Quantum Denmark, Copenhagen, Denmark. On-site.

Start: January 2027

Company Overview

Diasense is a deep-tech company turning fundamental quantum physics into world-class scientific instruments. We are building the world's most sensitive magnetic microscope, using nitrogen-vacancy centres in diamond to measure magnetic fields at a sensitivity that no other technique can reach.

We are applying that instrument to one of the hardest measurement problems in semiconductor manufacturing: seeing what is actually happening inside a finished chip, electrically and non-destructively. It is a market where the physics has to be exceptional and the engineering has to be industrial, and very few companies in the world are attempting both.

We are a spin-out of DTU Physics, based in the quantum center of Copenhagen, and we are about to move from a working prototype to instruments installed at customers’ sites. The team today is eight full-time and six part-time people. Over 2027 and 2028, we are building that to around thirty. By joining now, you will be one of the people who decide what this company becomes, not someone who inherits it.

Position Overview

Job Description

We are looking for the person who will own the quantum side of our instrument, outright.

You will lead our quantum function: a Quantum Lead, quantum engineers, and part-time specialists, growing over the next eighteen months. You are an experimentalist at heart. We are not looking for someone who manages a lab from a desk. We are looking for the person other physicists go to when something does not work, and nobody can say why. Today that person is our CTO, and your role is to change that. When the quantum work gets stuck, it should stop with you.

You will be joining at the transition point where the instrument moves from lab to customer sites. The physics has to keep improving, and it now also has to withstand contact with the real world. Both halves of that are yours.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Ownership of the Quantum Platform

• Own the performance of the NV-diamond measurement chain end to end: optical read-out, microwave control, sensitivity, noise floor and measurement protocols.

• Set the technical direction for how we push sensitivity and measurement speed over the next two years.

• Make the calls on where the physics effort goes, and be accountable for them.

Hands-on Experimental Work

• Spend the majority of your week in the lab, on the instrument, with your hands on it.

• Diagnose and fix the problems that have no procedure attached - the ones where the measurement is wrong and nobody yet knows why.

• Develop and prove new experimental protocols, rather than reviewing someone else's.

Leading and Building the Quantum Team

• Lead the quantum function: our Quantum Lead, quantum engineers and part-time academic specialists, with further hires planned through 2027.

• Raise what the team can do unaided. Success looks like fewer problems reaching you over time, not more.

• Own hiring for the quantum team as it grows, together with the CTO.

Instruments in the Field

• Take technical responsibility for the quantum performance of instruments installed at customer sites.

• Support and eventually supervise measurement campaigns at customer locations, so that deployment does not depend on the founders.

• Work closely with instrumentation, software and applications colleagues - this instrument only works when all four disciplines agree.

Qualifications & Experience

• A PhD in Physics, Quantum Optics, Atomic Physics or a closely related field, followed by substantial further experimental experience in academia or industry.

• Deep, sustained, hands-on experimental physics. Years at the bench, building and debugging experiments yourself. This is the single most important qualification and we will test for it.

• A demonstrable record of solving unfamiliar, hard experimental problems without supervision. We are interested in what you did when the standard approach failed.

• Experience guiding, mentoring or leading other researchers or engineers - formally or informally. You do not need to have held a management title, but you do need to want this half of the job.

• An inquisitive and stubborn mindset: willing to question assumptions, including your own, and to keep going after a problem that has already resisted three attempts.

• Fluency in Python or MATLAB for research-grade data analysis.

Experience with one or more of the following is a significant advantage:

• Cold atoms or trapped ions. Our techniques originate in cold-atom physics rather than in quantum sensing, and we have found that people trained in that tradition tend to carry exactly the debugging instinct this role needs.

• Magnetometry, especially with NV centres, and precision measurements.

• Microwave electronics and real-time control systems.

• Building complex free-space optical systems from components.

• Taking a laboratory technique out of the laboratory.

Compensation & Benefits

• A competitive salary package.

• An attractive warrant package. You will share directly in what you build, and at this stage the share is meaningful.

• Relocation support for you and your family, and assistance with the Danish researcher tax scheme, which for qualifying international hires taxes salary at a flat 32.84 percent for up to seven years.

• Denmark's quantum ecosystem at your door: DTU Physics, the Niels Bohr Institute and one of Europe's densest concentrations of quantum research.

• A small, senior team where decisions are made in a conversation rather than in a process.

USP's for this job

• You are the ceiling, not waiting for one. In most companies, the deepest technical authority sits above you, and you work within it. Here you are being hired to become it. The quantum direction of this instrument will be yours.

• Lead a team without leaving the lab. Almost every physicist who moves into leadership loses the bench. This role is explicitly designed so that you do not - the leadership comes from being the best experimentalist, not from stopping being one.

• Build the Unprecedented: You will be a leading the development and rollout of the most powerful magnetic microscope in the world, directly pushing the boundaries of scientific measurement.

• It leaves the building. Our instruments are going into customer laboratories. You will see your work measured by whether it survives in somebody else's fab, which is a rarer and more satisfying test than a paper.

• Early enough to matter. Fourteen people today, around thirty by the end of 2028. The people joining now set how this company works.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As a Senior Data Engineer - AI & Databricks , you will help shape how AI is adopted across Danfoss Climate Solutions, especially within our global sales organization.

Working as part of a global team of data, analytics, and AI professionals, you will build and evolve a trusted, scalable, and well-governed Databricks platform that enables sales teams across multiple regions and functions to turn data into actionable insights. Your work will support use cases such as sales forecasting, pipeline visibility, and customer insights, helping teams make faster, data-driven decisions.

By ensuring the platform is secure, high-quality, and continuously improving, you will enable reliable data products and Generative AI solutions that drive business value. Working closely with data engineers, analysts, product owners, and business stakeholders, you will help establish best practices and scale AI adoption across the organization.

Success in this role means delivering trusted, AI-ready data products that strengthen governance, accelerate AI adoption, and support better business decisions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Own and improve Databricks governance, including Unity Catalog, data access, security, and data quality

• Design and maintain scalable data architecture, ensuring best practices across data models, tables, and pipelines

• Enhance Genie spaces (AI-powered knowledge tools) by improving content, entity matching, and answer quality for end users

• Partner with cross-functional teams to enable adoption of data products and AI solutions that support data-driven sales decisions

• Evaluate and implement new Databricks and AI capabilities to improve platform performance and deliver measurable business value

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience with Databricks or similar cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Azure Synapse), including Unity Catalog and data governance practices

• Strong SQL and Python skills, with hands-on experience building scalable data models and modern ETL pipelines

• Proven ability to design and manage data platforms that enable analytics or AI use cases in a business environment

• Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders, translating data and AI capabilities into practical business solutions

• Fluent in English, with strong communication skills and a proactive interest in applying emerging AI technologies

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• Shape how AI is applied across global sales teams, driving measurable improvements in forecasting, pipeline visibility, and customer insights

• Work hands-on with Databricks, Unity Catalog, and Generative AI to build solutions used across multiple markets

• Influence how data and AI solutions are scaled globally, working with diverse teams and stakeholders

• Grow in a collaborative and international environment that supports continuous learning, innovation, and career development

• A competitive compensation package and flexible hybrid working model, with access to global opportunities

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you’re excited about building data platforms that power real-world AI applications and drive business decisions, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and explore how your work can shape the future of AI at Danfoss.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.occupation: Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions
jobs.description:
Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions  Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences
 Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
 University of Copenhagen

  The University seeks to appoint a tenure track assistant professor to commence 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. 

  Information on the department can be found at: http://www.sund.ku.dk/. 

  Subject area: Infectious disease epidemiology, modelling, animal health, One Health, and sustainable health systems

  The Tenure-Track Assistant Professor will lead research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, with particular emphasis on how changes in environmental conditions, animal populations, production systems, and management practices influence disease emergence, transmission, and control. The position will combine infectious disease epidemiology, mathematical and statistical modelling, data science, and economic analysis to generate evidence supporting disease preparedness, prevention, and control.

  The successful candidate will:

   	
• Lead independent research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, including the influence of environmental and production system changes. 	
• Develop and apply simulation, epidemiological, and statistical models to assess disease and spillover risks, evaluate mitigation and control strategies, and quantify their economic implications. 	
• Demonstrate strong programming skills in R and other relevant programming languages, including experience in managing, processing, and analysing large and complex datasets. 	
• Have experience in developing and applying epidemiological disease-spread models, including model calibration, validation, parameter estimation, and calculation of epidemiological indicators such as the basic reproduction number (R₀) across different animal species and production systems. 	
• Design and implement epidemiological modelling frameworks. 	
• Validate and calibrate models using large-scale national datasets, ensuring scientific robustness, methodological validity, and relevance for policy and decision-making. 	
• Translate research findings into evidence supporting risk-based disease prevention, preparedness, and control.  	
• Establish and maintain collaborations with key stakeholders, including the Danish Veterinary and Food Administration, industry partners such as SEGES and Landbrug & Fødevarer (L&F), and international organisations such as the FAO. 	
• Lead and secure independent research funding through competitive national and international funding calls. The position requires demonstrated experience in securing external funding, as well as the ambition to develop research ideas into externally funded projects and provide scientific leadership for such projects within the TIPTON Research Group. 	
• Contribute to the development and delivery of One Health and sustainability teaching, with a particular focus on infectious diseases, disease preparedness, and the interactions between animal, human, and environmental health. 	
• Contribute to teaching in data science, including data management, dataset preparation and handling, statistical analysis, programming, and the analysis of large-scale and complex datasets. 	
• Supervise students and contribute to research capacity building within infectious disease epidemiology, disease modelling, data science, and One Health. 	
• Contribute to the delivery of government services undertaken by the Department, including research-based advice, preparedness activities, risk assessments, and other activities relevant to infectious disease modelling and control.   The position is expected to combine methodological excellence in infectious disease modelling and data science with applied epidemiological research, generating evidence that is directly relevant to disease preparedness, private and public bodies, sustainable production systems, animal health and resilient health systems.

  The tenure track assistant professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of: 

   	
• research, including publication/academic dissemination 	
• research-based teaching  	
• sharing knowledge with society  	
• participation in formal pedagogical training programme for assistant professors    The tenure track assistant professor’s performance will be evaluated through annual evaluations. Furthermore, the tenure track assistant professor will be evaluated in a mid-track appraisal. 

  After no more than six years of employment and on condition of a positive final appraisal, the tenure track assistant professor will be employed as associate professor. Find more information about tenure track at the University of Copenhagen.

  Required qualifications 
 To be qualified for an assistant professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership. Find information about each criterion.

  Furthermore, each applicant must be able to document:

   	
• a PhD degree or similar qualifications within the subject area  	
• research experience within the field of the position    The tenure track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact. 

  The assistant professor is also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills. 

  Salary and employment conditions
 The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The position is permanent. 

  Employment is as Tenure Track Assistant Professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant professional organisations. 

  There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector at www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025. 

  Questions 
 For further information, please contact Research Group Leader: Professor Beate Conrady, bcon@sund.ku.dk

  Foreign applicants may find the university’s International Staff Mobility useful.

  Application 
 The application must be submitted in English, and must include the following documents: 

   	
• Application (Including motivation for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages)) 	
• Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding) 	
• Diplomas (Master’s, PhD and other relevant diplomas) 	
• A complete list of publications  	
• Research plan (2-4 pages) 	
• Teaching plan 	
• Uploads of maximum 5 publications to be considered in the assessment  	
• Teaching portfolio, if applicable (Guidelines)   Please note: It is mandatory to upload a teaching plan in the online application form. Should you not be able to produce a teaching plan, please upload a blank document in this box instead.

  Application procedure
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee.  All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's Job Portal.

  Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation. 

  The application will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities. 

  The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested in this post to apply. 

  Please submit the application with the required attachments. Only online applications will be accepted. The closing date for applications is 23.59 p.m. CET, 18 November 2026.

  Interviews for this position are likely to be held on 7 April 2027.

Your impact begins here

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will turn models and AI prototypes into reliable, secure and measurable production services in Research & Development. You will design, deploy and operate machine learning, generative AI and agent-based applications on Databricks, AWS and Azure, and set the engineering practices that keep them performing. Your work helps colleagues move from promising ideas to dependable tools they use every day, supporting progress for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

• A degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Typically, 5+ years in machine learning engineering, software engineering or applied AI, including ownership of production ML systems, with examples of your contribution, architecture decisions, deployment approach, operational challenges and measured outcomes.

• Strong hands-on Databricks expertise, including Python, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, MLflow, production pipelines, model serving, workflow orchestration and Unity Catalog governance.

• Strong practical knowledge of both AWS and Azure for deploying and operating ML or AI workloads, along with Git, CI/CD, containers and infrastructure as code, such as Terraform.

• Demonstrated implementation experience across MLOps, LLMOps, AgentOps and DataOps, from reproducible training, model registries and rollback to retrieval-augmented generation, safety testing, agent tracing, tool permissions, data contracts and lineage.

• Strong Python and SQL skills, solid machine learning fundamentals, experience with frameworks such as scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow, and practical experience building LLM applications with embeddings, retrieval, structured outputs and tool calling.

• Experience with observability, incident response and production support, an understanding of data privacy, security, responsible AI and model governance, and the communication skills to explain technical trade-offs and mentor colleagues.

Desirable, but not essential: Experience with Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI services, Amazon SageMaker or Amazon Bedrock; Kubernetes, GPU workloads and distributed training; feature stores, vector search, fine-tuning and agent orchestration frameworks; evaluation frameworks for probabilistic systems; or operating AI in regulated or security-sensitive environments. Relevant Databricks, AWS or Azure certifications are a plus.

What you’ll do

Your focus is AI that works in production: evaluated against agreed quality and safety criteria, delivering measurable value, and improving in reliability, latency and cost over time.

• Design, build, deploy and maintain ML models, LLM applications and AI agents, including batch and real-time inference services integrated into business applications.

• Build training, evaluation, deployment and monitoring workflows with Databricks and MLflow, and operate AI infrastructure on AWS and Azure that balances performance, reliability, security and cost.

• Establish MLOps, LLMOps, AgentOps and DataOps practices – covering versioning, automated testing, rollback, safety controls, human oversight and reliable, well-governed data.

• Monitor model quality, data drift, latency, availability and cost, investigate failures and define evaluation criteria that measure technical quality alongside business outcomes.

• Lead technical design discussions, review code, mentor engineers and document operational procedures to raise engineering standards across the team.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Data and Machine Learning Operations team in Research & Development, a team of machine learning, data, cloud and software engineers. In R&D, colleagues explore scientific ideas and advance them towards clinical testing, bringing curiosity, data, technology and operational excellence together.

You will work closely with data scientists, data engineers, software engineers and business stakeholders, turning their models and prototypes into services people can rely on. By leading design discussions and making technical trade-offs clear, you will help the team decide, own it and move at pace.

What you can expect here

You will work at the forefront of AI and technology, as Novo upskills its entire workforce to advance AI as a main driver for innovation for people living with serious chronic diseases. You will have the trust to own production systems end to end, shape engineering practices and make your voice heard in technical decisions.

You will grow alongside skilled colleagues on the job and through relevant learning offerings, in a culture with clear performance expectations where honest feedback and strong results are recognised.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000 to 956,900 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to build the data platforms that help research move forward, apply by 22 October 2026.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We are an equal opportunities employer and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants.

Ambu is a company with ambitious growth targets. We develop, produce, and sell innovative medical devices that support health care systems and enable doctors and nurses to save lives daily. Our ability to continue to identify and develop innovative products is essential for continuous growth and sustain the growing demand for our solutions. Do you want to be part of the team?

We are currently looking for a Global Product Manager (Upstream), who wants to take part in taking our EndoIntelligence area to the next level. You will be the commercial driver on one of our most exciting innovation projects for diagnostics, being responsible for representing the customer and delivering commercial activities throughout the project life cycle. AI will be a central part of the solution, making this a unique opportunity to work on a highly innovative offering with significant strategic importance for Ambu. You will be partnering with colleagues in R&D and other departments to bring to market an impactful solution with the potential to change clinical practices, which will strengthen Ambu’s position in the market and show our abilities within software.

You will work alongside the established team within EndoIntelligence and collaborate closely with other upstream colleagues, as well as pipeline, downstream and strategy, as we deliver on the overall vision. You will join an international and highly dedicated team, but also have strong ties in R&D, Sales Territories, etc. The position is based at Ambu’s headquarters in Ballerup, Denmark. Some traveling should be expected as a part of the job.

**Leading a groundbreaking project

****Responsibilities

**Our new Global Product Manager (Upstream) will be instrumental in increasing our innovation height, advancing our position in the market and accelerate our growth. Your responsibilities will include:

• Taking lead as the product manager for an important and exciting innovation project, where you own all commercial deliverables, incl. translating customer needs into powerful solutions and representing the customer in all activities

• Leading efforts to accelerate the project and focus on the in-market value, including following our launch excellence process and being the commercial voice on trade-offs

• Ensuring that the project is thinking in full solutions, and that the development project works according to our strategy and ambitions for digital solutions – including looking ahead and already think about future development opportunities

• Building strong relationships across the organization, to build momentum and alignment behind the solution and enable quick decision-making based on strong customer insights

• Taking part in over execution of our EndoIntelligence strategy incl. ensure cross-project alignment, collaboration with both pipeline and downstream and a general openness to support where the need is greatest

**Key competences

****Role

**To succeed in this role, you will bring strong upstream product management experience and combine it with customer understanding and the ability create results in a growing area. We imagine you bring:

• Experience within upstream product management with a strong focus on software. Addtional experience in hardware and AI is a strong benefit- ideally at the intersection of these domains

• Strong track record of designing and implementing initiatives to drive growth, build brand loyalty and take a leading position in a market

• A master's degree within Technology or Business or a related field

• Understanding of hospital systems and previous engagement with both clinical- and non-clinical stakeholders, to navigate the landscape and be their voice in the organization

• Experience in leading product innovation projects from concept to launch

• Ability to balance customer insights, technical considerations, and business priorities.

• Excellent collaboration skills, as the role is key for all other product management areas and relies on strong alignment across various functions

• A curious and positive mindset, that sees opportunities and wants to be part of shaping an area, as well as thriving in the role of a product manager, where the tasks as varied and can change

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits along with exciting job challenges and career opportunities contributing to your job satisfaction.

**When to apply

**If you are ready to apply for the position, please apply as soon as possible. We will invite candidates for interviews on a continuous basis so there is no need to hesitate.

Your application will be treated confidentially.
